purpose: Shared organizational transformation, read/write compatibility, ownership and concurrency.
use: Transforming shared organizational data or changing read/write compatibility: plan ownership, concurrency and verification of the migration.
semantic_conditions: Organizational migration is separate from runtime adoption and performed once under exclusive authority.
mandatory_preconditions: Canonical revision, actual state interpretation and reader/writer compatibility.
postconditions_verification: Migration result verified and canonically recorded without blind replay.
